name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya Sharma's journey into motorsport was sparked by a childhood fascination with the inner workings of engines. Growing up in Mumbai, she spent hours tinkering with her grandfather's old scooter, eventually enrolling in a mechanical engineering program. After graduating, she honed her skills in the automotive industry before making the leap to motorsport, drawn by the high-stakes environment and the constant push for innovation.

Priya is known for her meticulous approach to machining, believing that even the smallest imperfection can compromise performance. Her demanding nature pushes her team to strive for excellence, and she's constantly seeking new ways to improve the efficiency and reliability of the components she produces. Her dedication to precision and her relentless pursuit of perfection make her a valuable asset to MP Motorsport Junior.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and often tied back in a practical bun.
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a focused gaze and strong, capable hands.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils with a razor blade, even when a sharpener is available.
Insists on playing classical Indian music at a low volume in the workshop.
Keeps a small, well-worn copy of the Bhagavad Gita in her toolbox.
